title: Motorcycle Engine Architecture: In-line Fours vs V-Twins vs Parallel Twins & Slipper Clutches
description: Advanced motorcycle engineering module examining crankshaft firing orders (180° vs 270°), slipper clutch ramp mechanics, and quickshifter ignition cuts.
grammar_focus: Complex Passive Constructions & Degrees of Comparison
learning_objectives: Master advanced motorcycle engineering terms (crossplane crankshaft, slipper clutch, bi-directional quickshifter, IMU, ride-by-wire)
Apply inverted conditionals and complex passive reporting in motorcycle powertrain evaluations
Demonstrate fluency when drafting comparative engine reviews and mechanical diagnostic reports

questions.prompt: _____ motorcycle manufacturers not adopted 270-degree crossplane crankshafts, modern parallel twins would have lacked charismatic V-twin character.

explanations.correct: Inverted Third Conditional 'Had motorcycle manufacturers not adopted...' expresses a past counterfactual without 'if'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'If' requires the auxiliary 'had' after the subject.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Were' forms a Second Conditional, incompatible with past 'would have lacked'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Inverze 3. kondicionálu: 'Had manufacturers not adopted...' = 'Kdyby výrobci nezavedli...'. V podmínce se nepoužívá 'if' ani 'would'.

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ riders use passenger car engine oils containing energy-conserving molybdenum additives in wet clutch motorcycles.

explanations.correct: Negative introductory phrase 'Under no circumstances' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion: 'should motorcycle [riders use]'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'riders should' lacks the required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_B: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporná úvodní fráze 'Under no circumstances' vyžaduje převrácený slovosled (inverzi): 'Under no circumstances should riders use...'.

questions.prompt: If the suspension specialist had dialed in the rebound damping during track setup, the rear tire _____ cold tear patterns today.

explanations.correct: Mixed conditional: past cause ('had dialed in') with present ongoing result ('today') takes 'would not be showing'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would not have shown' refers purely to past result, but adverbial 'today' anchors consequence to the present.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will not show' is First Conditional, incompatible with past counterfactual condition.
explanations.wrong_D: Indicative 'does not show' cannot express hypothetical consequence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Smíšený kondicionál (Mixed Conditional): minulá příčina spojená s přítomným následkem: 'If he had dialed in [minulost], it would not be showing [dnes]'.

questions.prompt: FIM road racing technical regulations mandate that every competition machine _____ mechanical safety wire locks on oil drain plugs.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'mandate that' requires base form 'utilize' regardless of 3rd person singular subject.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'utilizes' with 3rd person -s violates mandative subjunctive syntax.
explanations.wrong_B: Future 'will utilize' is incorrect after mandative 'mandate that'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Subjunktiv po slovesech předpisů (mandate that every machine utilize): sloveso zůstává v základním tvaru bez -s.

questions.prompt: _____ an electronic bi-directional quickshifter, the trackday rider executed seamless full-throttle upshifts without using the clutch lever.

explanations.correct: Perfect active participle 'Having installed' correctly expresses prior hardware installation leading to subsequent clutchless shifts.
explanations.wrong_A: Base verb 'Install' cannot function as introductory participle.
explanations.wrong_B: Past form 'Installed' without auxiliary is passive, but the rider actively installed the quickshifter.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Being installed' expresses present passive, not completed prior action.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomné participium (Having installed = poté, co nainstaloval...) vyjadřuje děj dokončený před hlavní větou.

questions.prompt: _____ high-revving in-line four engines deliver ferocious top-end horsepower, low-RPM torque is far more usable on twisty mountain passes.

explanations.correct: 'Although' is a conjunction followed by a full clause with subject and verb ('high-revving in-line four engines deliver...').
explanations.wrong_A: 'In spite of' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase or gerund.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Notwithstanding' is followed by a noun phrase.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Despite' is a preposition and cannot be followed directly by a finite clause.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'Although' (ačkoli) se pojí s celou větou s podmětem a slovesem, zatímco předložky jako 'Despite' a 'In spite of' vyžadují podstatné jméno.

questions.prompt: Ride-by-wire electronic throttle mapping is confirmed _____ snatchy low-speed fuel injection responses on modern big-bore motorcycles.

explanations.correct: Perfect active infinitive 'to have eliminated' correctly attributes an established technological advance to electronic throttles.
explanations.wrong_A: Present infinitive 'to eliminate' implies future or ongoing elimination rather than proven technological fact.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'eliminating' cannot follow passive reporting verb 'is confirmed'.
explanations.wrong_C: Passive 'to have been eliminated' incorrectly treats electronic throttles as the object rather than the driving cause.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'is confirmed to have eliminated' (je potvrzeno, že eliminovalo) vyjadřuje minulý děj pomocí minulého infinitivu.

questions.prompt: Only after fitting an inverted cartridge front fork _____ the high-speed chatter under heavy braking into corners.

explanations.correct: Limiting introductory phrase 'Only after...' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Past Simple: 'did the test rider cure'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'the test rider cured' lacks required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_C: 'cured the test rider' is archaic full inversion without auxiliary 'did'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present perfect conflicts with completed past track testing.

questions.cz_learning_point: Zdůrazňující úvodní vazba 'Only after...' vyžaduje inverzní slovosled: 'Only after fitting a fork did the rider cure...'.

questions.prompt: With audible mechanical tapping echoing from the top cylinder head at idle, the valve shims _____ within factory clearance tolerances.

explanations.correct: 'Cannot possibly be operating' expresses absolute deductive impossibility based on clear valve train noise.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must not' expresses prohibition or deduction of absence.
explanations.wrong_B: 'should not' expresses moral obligation or advice.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vyjádření naprosté nemožnosti: 'cannot possibly be operating' (v žádném případě nemohou ventily fungovat v toleranci, když takto klepou).

questions.prompt: Modern superbikes incorporate a six-axis inertial measurement unit (IMU), in accordance with _____ traction control and slide control intervene.

explanations.correct: Formal prepositional relative phrase 'in accordance with which' strictly takes 'which' when modifying an IMU sensor.
explanations.wrong_A: 'that' cannot follow a preposition in formal relative clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po předložkách v rozvitých vztažných větách se pro technické senzory používá výhradně 'which': 'in accordance with which' (v souladu s nímž).
